idea-plugin.name: Jolta
idea-plugin.description:
Hands-off JDK selection from your project's .java-version, powered by jolta — like Volta, but for Java.
  • Sets the project SDK, Gradle JVM, and Maven importer JDK from the jolta pin — nothing to configure.
  • Live: jolta pin 25 in any terminal and the IDE switches immediately.
  • Installs the pinned JDK in the background when it's missing.
  • Survives jolta upgrade — SDK entries are repointed, never left dangling.
Requires the jolta CLI (brew install OneAppPlatform/tap/jolta).
